It sounds so lonely and longing.''"<br />"''It roughly translates as, 'Nobody likes us but we don't care, because we're Mandos, and we're the best.' Sorry to spoil the illusion.|[[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] and [[Goran Beviin]]|<ref name="Revelation">''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]''</ref>}}
A [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] drinking [[Music/Legends|chant]] was believed to have originated from a ban on [[Geris VI]] that prohibited Mandalorian [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] in the employ of the [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] government, from [[Alcohol/Legends|drinking]] in the local [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcafs]].<ref name="TC" />

In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[41 ABY]], a group of Mandalorian revelers sang this song during a celebration at [[Levet]]'s [[Levet's farm|farm]] on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]],<ref name="Revelation" /> the Mandalorians' cultural [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], who was on Mandalore and staying at the nearby [[Beviin-Vasur farm]] at the [[Time/Legends|time]], heard the singing from down the dirt road and believed it to be a love song, attributing a much deeper meaning to its mournful tone due to her lack of knowledge of the [[Mando'a/Legends|''Mando'a'']] [[Language/Legends|language]]. However, after speaking with her host, [[Goran Beviin]], the true nature of the song was explained to Solo, though she preferred her own interpretation to the much simpler truth.<ref name="Revelation" />

==Behind the scenes==
This drinking chant was first introduced to ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the opening epigraph of the tenth chapter of the ''[[Republic Commando]]'' novel, ''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''. [[Author/Legends|Authored]] by [[Karen Traviss]] and published [[October 30]], [[2007]], the epigraph included a brief history of where the chant originated in the ''Star Wars'' universe.<ref name="TC" /> The drinking chant resurfaced again in Traviss' third entry in the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'' series, ''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]'', published the following year on [[February 26]], [[2008]].<ref name="Revelation" />

The chant bears a strong resemblance to the British [[Wikipedia:Association football|association football]] chant, [[Wikipedia:No One Likes Us – We Don't Care|No One Likes Us – We Don't Care]]. In addition to the fact that Traviss is a native of Britain, further evidence for the chant's inspiration can be found in that the chant features a series of simple word replacements that feature the Mandalorians and their world in place of the [[Wikipedia:Millwall F.C.|Millwall F.C.]] and its fans.
